collection.title: Kia Rio Hatchback 2000 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Kia Rio Hatchback 2000 to 2004 model which requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
